title.zh: 将北三宝颜省卡拉维特市镇Angelina Dumajel小学的名称变更为巴塔扬小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Angelina Dumajel Elementary School in the Municipality of Kalawit, Zamboanga Del Norte, to Batayan Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Angelina Dumajel Elementary School in the Municipality of Kalawit, Zamboanga Del Norte, to Batayan Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Angelina Dumajel tại Thị trấn Kalawit, Zamboanga Del Norte thành Trường tiểu học Batayan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Angelina Dumajel ในเทศบาล Kalawit, Zamboanga Del Norte เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Batayan
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Angelina Dumajel di Kotamadya Kalawit, Zamboanga Del Norte menjadi Sekolah Dasar Batayan
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Angelina Dumajel di Perbandaran Kalawit, Zamboanga Del Norte menjadi Sekolah Rendah Batayan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7708_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Angelina Dumajel Elementary School in the Municipality of Kalawit, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, is hereby changed to Batayan Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its publication in at least two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
